verses.text: Do not make idols for yourselves. Do not set up carved statues or holy stone pillars, and do not put carved stones in your land to bow down to them. For I am the LORD your God.
Keep my Sabbath days and respect my holy place. I am the LORD.
If you live by my rules and carefully obey my commands,
I will send you rain at the right time. The land will give its crops, and the trees in the fields will give their fruit.

Your harvesting of grain will last until it is time to pick grapes, and your picking of grapes will last until it is time to plant. You will have all the food you want, and you will live safely in your land.
I will give peace in the land. You will lie down to sleep, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove dangerous animals from the land, and war will not pass through your country.
You will chase your enemies, and they will be killed by the sword in front of you.
Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand. Your enemies will be killed by the sword in front of you.
I will look on you with kindness. I will give you many children and make you grow in number, and I will keep my covenant with you.
You will still be eating last year's harvest when you have to clear it out to make room for the new.
I will put my home among you, and I will not turn away from you.
I will walk among you. I will be your God, and you will be my people.
I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt so that you would no longer be their slaves. I broke the heavy wooden bar from your necks and let you walk with your heads held high.
But if you will not listen to me and will not obey all these commands,
if you reject my rules and hate my laws, and refuse to obey all my commands, and so break my covenant,

then this is what I will do to you: I will bring sudden terror on you, wasting diseases and fever that will make your eyes fail and your life drain away. You will plant your seed for nothing, because your enemies will eat the crops.
I will turn against you, and your enemies will defeat you. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will run away even when no one is chasing you.
If after all this you still will not listen to me, I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
I will break your proud strength. I will make the sky above you like iron, giving no rain, and the ground under you as hard as bronze.
All your hard work will be for nothing, because your land will not give its crops, and the trees will not give their fruit.
If you still go against me and refuse to listen to me, I will strike you seven times more, as your sins deserve.
I will send wild animals among you. They will take your children, destroy your cattle, and make you few. Your roads will be empty.
If even after these things you do not turn back to me, but keep going against me,
then I myself will go against you. I myself will strike you seven times for your sins.
I will bring war on you to punish you for breaking my covenant. When you gather in your cities for safety, I will send disease among you, and you will be handed over to your enemies.
When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will be able to bake all your bread in one oven, and they will hand it out by weight. You will eat, but you will not be full.
If in spite of all this you still do not listen to me, but keep going against me,
then in my anger I will go against you. I myself will punish you seven times for your sins.
You will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.
I will destroy your places of idol worship and cut down your incense altars. I will pile your dead bodies on the lifeless bodies of your idols, and I will turn away from you in disgust.
I will turn your cities into ruins and leave your holy places empty. I will not enjoy the pleasing smell of your offerings.
I will make your land so empty that even your enemies who come to live there will be shocked.
I will scatter you among the nations, and I will pull out my sword and chase after you. Your land will be empty, and your cities will be in ruins.
Then, all the time the land lies empty while you are in the land of your enemies, it will enjoy its Sabbath years. The land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
All the time it lies empty, it will have the rest it did not have during your Sabbath years when you lived there.

As for those of you who are left alive in the lands of your enemies, I will make them so afraid that the sound of a leaf blowing in the wind will make them run. They will run as if running from a sword, and they will fall even when no one is chasing them.
They will trip over one another as if running from a sword, even when no one is chasing them. You will not be able to stand up against your enemies.
You will die among the nations. The land of your enemies will swallow you up.
Those of you who are left will waste away in the lands of your enemies because of their sins, and because of the sins of their fathers too.
But they may confess their sins and the sins of their fathers, how they were unfaithful to me and went against me,
which made me go against them and bring them into the land of their enemies. If their proud hearts are humbled and they accept the punishment for their sins,
then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.

For the land will be left empty by them, and it will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies empty without them. They will accept the punishment for their sins, because they rejected my laws and hated my rules.

Yet in spite of all this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them or hate them so much that I destroy them completely and break my covenant with them. For I am the LORD their God.
For their sake I will remember the covenant I made with their ancestors, whom I brought out of Egypt while the nations watched, to be their God. I am the LORD."
These are the rules, laws, and teachings that the LORD gave on Mount Sinai through Moses, between himself and the people of Israel.
